description: Brand identity and AI image-asset generation for the Unicorn Commander suite. Lists brands, reads a brand identity, composes prompts, generates assets, browses the asset catalog, and bootstraps new brand kits.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brand slugs seeded under the brand kits directory.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Get one brand's identity: colors, fonts, voice, tagline, and references.

tools.name: list_asset_types
tools.description: List the asset-type registry. Each entry has key, label, size, default_backend, and transparent.

tools.name: build_prompt
tools.description: Compose the image prompt for a brand asset without generating anything. A dry run through the same engine live generation uses. No backend is called and no spend occurs.

asset.description: Asset type key, for example og_image.

variant.description: Optional variant name allowed by the asset's prompt template.

topic.description: Optional topic, used by text-heavy assets like og_image.

platform.description: Optional platform hint, used by social_card.

backend.description: Optional backend override: gemini, openai, recraft, or flux.

tools.name: list_generated_assets
tools.description: List previously generated assets from the on-disk catalog by reading the sidecar JSON records next to each generated image.

brand.description: Optional brand slug to restrict the listing to one brand.

asset.description: Optional asset-type key to restrict the listing to one type.

tools.name: generate_asset
tools.description: Generate a brand asset and persist it with a sidecar catalog record. Routes through the same engine the CLI and REST API use. Returns needs_key when the chosen backend has no credentials configured.

asset.description: Asset type key, for example og_image.

variant.description: Optional variant name allowed by the asset's prompt template.

topic.description: Optional topic, used by text-heavy assets like og_image.

platform.description: Optional platform hint, used by social_card.

backend.description: Optional backend override: gemini, openai, recraft, or flux.

tools.name: new_brand
tools.description: Bootstrap a new brand kit from the blank template. Copies the template to a new brand directory and replaces the placeholder tokens with the supplied slug, display name, and optional parent slug.

slug.description: Filesystem-safe identifier for the new brand, for example majiks-studio.

display_name.description: Human-readable brand name, for example Majiks Studio.

parent.description: Optional parent brand slug if this is a sub-brand.
